svg.text: Promise-to-proof agent fleet for federal grants
2 Cloud Run services · Pub/Sub · Firestore · Vertex AI
Four human-paced agents sharing one working set
one consistency check, narrative vs budget
diffs award vs proposal, derives obligations
Split out: the only high-volume, retry-heavy component
walks any fact back to the event that caused it
constant for the whole award lineage
sha256 derived, so at-least-once becomes exactly-once
written in the same transaction as the output
MODEL_ID env var, one swap point
not a line in a log
• Consistency exception, three concrete resolutions offered
• Determination that turns on a fact about the world
• SF-425 certification by an authorised official
SEVEN DETERMINATIONS, EACH CITING THE PARAGRAPH THAT PRODUCED IT
The determination is deterministic and citable. The model writes the question, never the verdict.
A cost that matches no rule escalates. Silence is never approval.
The same agents and the same event contract run over an in-process bus with no cloud dependency and no installed packages.
Byte-identical every run, provenance chain included. A demo path that never touches the network cannot fail because of the network.
